entries.title: Another computer names your first mate's computer in task records, its own cards and lines that say here
entries.body: When you control your first mate from another computer, a task's record, the cards your first mate's computer puts up itself, and lines that said here, such as where a project's next task starts, now name the computer your first mate lives on, such as MacBook Pro. Your own words and a crewmate's keep their wording, and your first mate's own computer shows everything as before.

picture.alt: On a computer controlling the first mate, the card asking to update another computer says MacBook Pro has the newer Infinitary
